scheme_name: Swachh Bharat Mission Urban – SWM Startup Support
overview: Swachh Bharat Mission Urban – SWM Startup Support is a component of the Swachh Bharat Mission Urban 2.0 initiative launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) to foster innovation in solid waste management by supporting startups in the sanitation and waste-management sector. The scheme aims to nurture clean-tech startups through showcases, demo days, and partnerships with incubation centres like SIIC, IIT Kanpur. It aligns with the broader mission goals of achieving garbage-free cities and promoting sustainable waste management practices.
objectives: Nurture the evolving ecosystem of the Indian waste sector
Provide startups with a treasure trove of experience, knowledge and learnings
Help startups navigate their way in the sanitation and waste-management sector
Enable startups to take their solutions to scale
Facilitate reverse pitches by Urban Local Bodies to highlight ground-level challenges
Motivate startups to work on innovative solutions to sector-specific challenges
eligibility: Startups operating in the sanitation and waste-management sector are eligible to participate in the Swachhata Startup Challenge and related initiatives under SBM-U 2.0, as evidenced by the launch of cohorts of clean-tech startups in partnership with incubation centres.
benefits: Startups gain access to showcases and demo days at events like the Swachhata Startup Conclave, opportunities for reverse pitching to Urban Local Bodies, mentorship, knowledge transfer, and potential scaling of solutions through MoHUA’s partnerships with incubation centres such as SIIC, IIT Kanpur.
financial_support: The scheme does not specify direct financial grants or loans to startups; instead, it provides non-financial support through showcases, demo days, and access to incubation and innovation centres. Financial support, if any, is channeled through State/UT Capacity Building Funds under SBM-U 2.0, which mentor and mentee cities in initiatives like Swachh Shehar Jodi may leverage.
application_process: 1. Participate in the Swachhata Startup Challenge launched by MoHUA in partnership with DPIIT & AFD. 2. Submit proposals through the designated portal or process announced by MoHUA. 3. Undergo evaluation by the selection committee. 4. Shortlisted startups are invited to the Swachhata Startup Conclave. 5. Selected startups are showcased and given a platform to present their solutions. 6. Engage in reverse pitches with Urban Local Bodies to address ground-level challenges.
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round as per the Swachhata Startup Challenge announcements.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
caveats: The scheme does not provide direct financial grants; support is primarily through incubation, showcases, and knowledge sharing.
Participation is contingent on selection through competitive challenges like the Swachhata Startup Challenge.
Startups must operate in the sanitation and waste-management sector to be eligible.
